risks.title: Economic Recession
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly identifies periods of economic slowdown or recession as a material risk factor that could adversely affect financial results and ability to distribute dividends to shareholders.
risks.summary: Economic recession could materially adversely affect the company's financial condition, operating results, cash flows, and ability to make distributions to shareholders.

risks.title: Tenant Insolvency
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on lease payments from tenants. Tenant defaults and bankruptcies pose a material risk to rental income collection and cash flow.
risks.summary: Tenant defaults and insolvencies could reduce rental income and impair the company's ability to service debt obligations.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive real estate market where competitors may offer more favorable terms to tenants, potentially reducing rental rates and tenant retention.
risks.summary: Increased competition could reduce rental rates and make it more difficult to attract and retain tenants.

risks.title: Development and Redevelopment Risks
risks.score_rationale: Development and redevelopment projects carry execution risks including cost overruns, construction delays, and financing difficulties. The company has obligations under completion guarantees.
risks.summary: Development risks including cost overruns, delays, and financing challenges could negatively impact financial performance and project completion.

risks.title: Pandemics and Public Health Crises
risks.score_rationale: Public health emergencies could materially disrupt tenant operations, retail spending, and property operations similar to impacts observed during COVID-19.
risks.summary: Pandemics or health crises could significantly impact tenant operations, retail demand, and the company's ability to collect rents.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Rising inflation increases operating costs including insurance, property taxes, utilities, and labor, while limiting rent growth and tenant affordability.
risks.summary: Inflation could increase operating costs and limit the company's ability to raise rents, adversely affecting profitability.

risks.title: Natural Disaster Risks
risks.score_rationale: Natural disasters such as fires, earthquakes, and floods (evidenced by Tropical Storm Chantal impact in 2025) can damage properties and disrupt operations. The company currently has one property (Eastgate Crossing) reclassified from operating portfolio due to flooding.
risks.summary: Natural disasters could damage properties and disrupt operations, with negative impact on financial results and ability to operate.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
